cache_policy: source_cache_bytes=0; fresh process per cell; no application cross-query SOURCE cache; provider cache eviction unproven
interruption_policy: Spot interruption or incomplete full cell invalidates the entire paired attempt; retain original handles and completed-cell create-only checksum-HEAD checkpoints; no automatic replacement or retry.
payload_visibility: Only automatic validators consume payloads; operator/agents inspect no result/query/corpus/truth payload until campaign terminal.
percentile_method: nearest rank: sorted samples[ceil(p*N)-1]; paired p95 independently B1/A1 and B2/A2; pooled p90 concatenates both repetitions
retry_policy: Retain every valid slow cell and native bounded SDK retry in actual tails/CPU/transport cost. No slow-cell exclusion.
simulated_source_checked_predictions: Storage objection: breadth reduction must include physical SDK traffic and valid slow retries; retain all cells and existing transport summaries.

Evaluator objection: cross-arm exact parity would reject the intended quality tradeoff; compare each arm against its own closed 1000-query reference, retain historical 99.02% and 98.52% points. Simulated objections are not testimony or an extra review.
